items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I know a whole lot of them when they started... Like Tony Almanric, I remember Tony Almanric when he didn't know who the horn was.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember him. I remember him good. In fact, I know a whole lot of musicians, but I know a whole lot of them when they started. They do a whole lot of them when they wind up. Like Tony Almanric, I remember Tony Almanric when he didn't know who the horn was. Tony Almanric, his dad had a big boat I tried to buy. Oh,
